decisions.reason: The module builds directly on the firm's established sheet-handling and finishing knowledge, and its continued own-page presence suggests the firm can assimilate and improve it, so the probability of dropping is low.

The folding add-on is close to the firm's core folding/binding expertise and has a documented customer application showing successful combined creasing, perforating, cutting, and folding, indicating the firm can apply its knowledge and should keep it.
